name: Hotel Sonne
beschreibung: Hotel Sonne is situated right in the pedestrian centre of Ischgl, just steps from the valley station of the Silvrettabahn. The 4-star superior hotel expertly blends Tyrolean tradition with modern luxury. In winter, guests enjoy effortless ski-in/ski-out access to the world-class Silvretta Arena, while summer brings high-alpine hiking trails. Highlights include an expansive wellness spa with an indoor pool, saunas, and relaxation areas, alongside fine gourmet dining.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Sonne in central Ischgl features 4-star superior comfort, an indoor pool, a sauna wellness world, gourmet dining, and ski-in/ski-out proximity to the Silvrettabahn.
